name: jev-input-standardizer
description: Preview and accept Jev-standardized drafts in the target model's native format.

interface.longDescription: Uses Alt+G in the Codex composer for a TUI-safe preview and acceptance flow. In one fan-out, Jev chooses semantic boundaries, reviews bounded typo and question edits, flags downstream research, marks the earlier turns the draft depends on, and renders it in the target model's standard format (Markdown sections for GPT, XML for Claude) before the accepted payload returns to the composer.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how to use the Jev preview hotkey in Codex.
